contract.task_clause:
Which of the following procedures would an accountant least likely perform during an engagement to review the financial statements of a nonissuer?
Option A: Make inquiries of management about actions taken at board of directors' meetings.
Option B: Study the relationships of financial statement elements expected to conform to predictable patterns.
Option C: Identify internal control activities that are likely to prevent or detect material misstatements.
Option D: Compare the financial statements with anticipated results in budgets and forecasts.
